inputs: registered train and ordinary development positions; complete patches as in relations v1; observed X in frozen training coordinates, paired estimated S/O used for scoring
primary: repeat the relations posterior event occupancy contrast and Hb-history comparison with C seed 17; seed 43 is a same-population sensitivity
readout: inherited grouped training CV for conditional shrunk, person-balanced shrunk and background-residual codebook ridge for EEG band power, envelope and patch RMS
members_and_sequence: inherit relations A/C including failures, exact transition and dwell nulls, adjacent-crop sensitivity, matched nonlinear family main effects and continuous observation reference
events_and_hb: inherit relations B/D, masks, clocks, grouped lag selection and nulls; compare support and baseline to retained control
context: per development person choose up to 32 complete windows by fixed RNG 1125; donor is a disjoint complete window of same record and position. Replace all but central 2s; compare center ID and training-derived quartile family, and identity replay. Smoothness at artificial joins is uncontrolled.
visuals: full observed and integer-decoded 30s X/S/O, exact IDs and training-derived families with two-second zoom; locked median/difficult EEG and retained Hb examples. All other endpoints receive figures.
null: no improvement over matched background, bag or Hb history as appropriate; unchanged central patch has identical assignment under context replacement
stopping: fixed panel and checkpoints, once per seed; preserve missing support and failures; no pretraining
